title: Two expressions for restricted Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. The restricted Fourier weight equals the sum, over all subsets $T$ of the coordinates outside $J$, of the squared Fourier coefficients at the union of the lifted frequency sets from $S$ and $T$; moreover, this sum equals the uniform mean over sign assignments outside $J$ of the squared restricted Fourier coefficient.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function on the n-dimensional sign cube
finite coordinate set J in Fin n
